newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR Settlement accepts 675,100 JR West share bids.
newsitem.headline: JNR Settlement accepts 675,100 JR West share bids.

text.p: The number of bids accepted for shares in West Japan Railway Co Ltd (JR West) totalled 675,100 of the 750,000 shares offered, the Japan National Railways(JNR) Settlement Corp said Tuesday.
JNR said the highest bid for the JR West shares was 500,000 yen and the lowest was 282,000 yen.
JNR said the largest number of bids was concentrated in the 350,000-360,000 yen range, totalling 91,650.
There were 2,450 bids over 450,000 yen and 9,000 bids in the 282,000-290,000 yen range, it said.

Shares in JR West, part of the formerly state-owned Japan Railways group, will be listed on Japanese bourses on October 8. JR West is planning to sell 1.7 million shares out of the two million that have been already issued.
JNR said the auction price will be announced on August 29.
Japan National Railway Settlement Corp, which is a state-owned body, now holds all the shares in JR West.
